summary: Split tally/reports.py into the tally/reports/ package (errors, tables, state, system, formatting, model, loading, aggregate, renderers, cli; all files under 400 lines, layered, acyclic) with the public API, __all__ and renderer order unchanged, private names no longer re-exported, state and patch points homed in state.py/system.py, tests' mock.patch targets and tally/digest.py imports updated.
